subtasks: Hang all the mugs on the mug rack.
Hang the pink mug by its handle on the empty upper right branch of the rack, then release it.
Hang the red mug by its handle on an empty left branch of the rack using the left arm, then release it and return both open arms home.
Recover the red mug in front of the rack base with the left gripper and hang it by its handle on the lower-left branch. Release it, then return both open arms home.
All three mugs are released on the rack. Leave them undisturbed and return both fully open grippers to the initial low home poses.
